speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-month-old boy experiencing feeding difficulties and abdominal distension. To help me understand what is wrong, can you tell me if you have been passing stool and gas normally?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception. The combination of acute abdominal distension, severe tenderness (crying when touched), and feeding difficulties in an 8-month-old is highly suggestive of intussusception until proven otherwise. I am requesting an Ultrasound of the abdomen to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Ultrasound_Abdomen
